create_fake_quantize_function: create a fake_quantize_function that performs APoT quantization and dequantization with a mask for gradient clipping
build_quantize_APoT: build a quantize_APoT call to quantize a tensor with alpha, gamma, quantization_levels, and level_indices parameters
build_dequantize_APoT: build a dequantize_APoT call to dequantize a quantized tensor back to its original precision
test_forward_method: test the forward method of fake_quantize_function with tensor inputs and APoT quantization parameters
test_backward_method: test the backward method of fake_quantize_function that applies a mask to gradient output
